content_sections.text: The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and experience for candidates with exceptional credentials.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Associate-I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 11 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Maths/Information Technology/Data Science and Artificial Intelligence or MCA.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting. Online interview. Eligible candidates will be notified by email and invited for Online interview.

faq.question: Q7. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially for 3 months on contract basis, may be extendable up to nine months based on performance and availability of fund.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Calicut.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Registration form; Recent CV; Mark sheets/certificates in support of academic qualification/experience; No Objection Certificate (if already in employment).

faq.question: Q10. What should the subject line of the email be?
faq.answer: Email the documents to [email protected] and copy to [email protected] with subject line "Application for Project Staff In MoSPI Project".
